title: 2023 Panini Select Justin Jefferson Numbers #NMB-JJE Minnesota Vikings
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2023 Panini Select sports trading card features Justin Jefferson of the Minnesota Vikings. The card is an insert from the 2023 set and has the card number NMB-JJE. It also has features such as the player's name, team, and league. The card is perfect for collectors who are fans of football and the National Football League (NFL).

The card is not autographed and is a great addition to any sports trading card collection. It is manufactured by Panini and is a single trading card. Get this card now to add to your collection or to give as a gift to a fellow sports fan.
